sketch:
Observe: NPN transistor schematic with base current I_B slider and a
collector-emitter voltage V_CE slider; live plot of I_C vs. V_CE
curves for several I_B values (fan of characteristics). Zones
cut-off / linéaire / saturation are colour-banded. Experiment: use
transistor as switch — feed base with a square wave and watch a lamp
in the collector branch blink; then use as amplifier — feed base with
a small sinusoid and observe scaled output. Evaluate: given a target
output amplitude, pick R_B and R_C. Wrinkle: β variation across a
batch introduces tolerance.
